assumptions: Linear elastic, small-displacement Timoshenko bending with explicit effective shear areas.
Shear areas are caller-supplied diagnostics; no native-input qualification or corpus promotion is implied.
Only nodal/point and piecewise-constant distributed loads are supported in finite-shear mode.
EB and Timoshenko displacements can differ physically; request tolerances are not adjusted.
No mass is added by observation/load subdivision; this solver performs static analysis only.
Commercial-engine comparisons are diagnostic, not same-engine native truth.

nativeWrenchConversion.status: Validated only for these observed BEAM/COLUMN output conventions; general geometric transform is an implementation recipe requiring convention qualification per native class.
nativeWrenchConversion.axisMatrixDefinition: Rows of Rn/Rs are native/source right-handed local axes in global coordinates; Q=Rs@Rn.T.
nativeWrenchConversion.formula: h_source = Ds(sourceEndpoint) @ block_diag(Q,Q) @ Dn(nativeEndpoint) @ h_native; endpoints matched by physical coordinates/connectivity, not index.
prerequisites: Decode SDK field order and diagram signs per element/output family before rotation.
Identify first/last physical endpoints, native/source local axes and station origins independently.
Cut forces/diagram signs are not vector components until converted to resisting wrench.
Coincident physical endpoints/cuts required; offsets require explicit moment transport M_new=M_old+r_cross_F and known origin direction.
For reversed connectivity map s_source=L-s_native and map endpoint diagonal accordingly.
No arbitrary rolled or inclined member, MM-079 slant column, releases, rigid offsets, internal point-load side or nonlinear semantics qualified here.
nativeWrenchConversion.precision: Native section forces are float32; assembly compared with SDK float64 support reactions. Tiny native DIR rounding retained.

nineStationEquilibrium.abscissaPolicy: Explicit diagnostic candidate s=i*L/8, supported by this CS=7 output and uniform-load equilibrium; no native position array was returned. Not a general arbitrary-station location qualification.
nineStationEquilibrium.formulas: N,T constant; V2 constant; V3(s)=V3(0)+wz*s; M2(s)=M2(0)-V3(0)*s-wz*s^2/2; M3(s)=M3(0)+V2(0)*s.
